description: Cells are generated by a model fitted on each context's own control cells: PCA of the highly variable genes, a new state sampled near an observed one, the composition decoded as the mean of the 30 nearest control cells, and per-gene Gamma-Poisson dispersion matched to the controls' zero fractions. No control cell is copied into the prediction. With no predicted effect this generator makes 0.5 significant genes per perturbation against held-out controls of the same context (400 cells, Wilcoxon, per-target BH); the generator of our 2026-09-13 submission made 462. The predicted effect for a target is its own effect in Replogle 2022 K562 genome-wide Perturb-seq, read from the single-cell file (1,989,578 cells) as the log ratio of mean per-cell fractions with an empirical-Bayes shrinkage from the between-cell standard error, applied at amplitude 1.0; 269 of the 300 targets are covered. On top of it, a CRISPRi cis term: a gene whose TSS lies within 5 kb of the target's and that K562 measured takes its own K562 effect, and the remaining neighbours take a median-by-distance prior fitted on the K562 targets outside the panel. No perturbed data from contexts A, B or C was used. Amplitudes were chosen by a rule written before the benches existed, on a K562 -> HepG2 transfer bench scored with cell-eval2 0.16.0.
